summary: Gorax breaks down the upcoming Wish Summons banner, comparing it to the First Blush summons and explaining how to best configure the hero pool. Unlike earlier summons limited to Season 1 heroes, Wish Summons allows players to select newer exclusive DPS and legendary supports, offering milestone copies up to an 800-pull milestone and a 1,000-pull exclusive 50/50 pity. Gorax recommends targeting key anchors like Serpentemis for Poison or Beldelle for Ice Blast, while advising players to skip Elecebre's banner due to power creep. He also outlines the upcoming banner sequence, including new school damage banners and high-priority exclusive support reruns like Reytah and Grishnaar.

heroes.name: Reytah

teams.note: Poison team built around Serpentemis that reliably auto-clears high-end PvE content and dungeons.
F2P-friendly single-target Ice Blast composition relying on Beldelle with her exclusive artifact.

tips: Skip the Siren Song (Elecebre) banner starting October 1st and save dice for Wish Summons on October 11th.
Use Wish Summons to round out a dedicated team archetype (such as Beldelle for Ice Blast or Serpentemis for Poison) rather than picking scattered heroes.
Spenders should prioritize reaching Inspiration 2 or Inspiration 5 on key anchors like Serpentemis for massive damage boosts.
Plan ahead for upcoming seasonal banners: brand-new exclusive supports arrive first, followed in order by three Damage School banners (Aura, Shadow, and Corrosion).
